note: Honest runtime-enforcement record for the execution boundary. Every file that contains a network or child-process primitive MUST be listed here (enforcement-coverage.test.mjs fails otherwise). UNCOVERED means: the boundary does NOT gate this path.

classes.BOUNDARY_WIRED: calls execution-boundary.check before acting (runtime enforced, tested)
classes.VIA_BOUNDARY_WIRED_CALLER: performs the primitive only when called by a boundary-wired module
classes.LOOPBACK_ONLY: talks to 127.0.0.1 / the local model server only
classes.LOCAL_PROCESS_SANDBOXED: spawns a local process under Node's permission model / fixed command; no network by construction where the host supports it; NOT gated by the incident boundary (SEC-GAP-5)
classes.LOCAL_PROCESS_OWNER_TOOLING: spawns owner-initiated tooling (git/node --check, update adapters' syntax check, own runtime child). The update self-test runs through restricted-node (gated) but other spawns here are NOT gated by the incident boundary (remaining part of SEC-GAP-5)
classes.QUARANTINED_LEGACY: legacy runtime file; never started, registered or activated
classes.PROCESS_GATED: spawns a local process only after calling process-gate (execution boundary: incident block on the acting agent via ambient actor, owner stop); runtime-enforced, tested in process-gate.test.mjs. Not OS-level isolation.
classes.PROCESS_GATED_VIA_RESTRICTED_NODE: spawns only with a command built by restricted-node.mjs, which calls process-gate first (so it inherits PROCESS_GATED); the gate is verified by the process-gate tests, the call site is not individually asserted.
